279726754.description:
[Unmarked]
Brass-Tone Metal Double Inkwell Set
Victorian Style, Mid-20th Century or Earlier
This ornate desk set features a central gnome or elf figure with a long beard and pointed cap, situated between two lidded inkwells. The base is heavily decorated with scrolling foliate motifs and includes a built-in pen tray at the front. The set reflects the whimsical and highly decorative Aesthetic and Victorian movements, often incorporating mythological or folklore figures into functional household items. The set is accompanied by a horse-head letter opener and a small spoon with a bust-handle finial.
Cast metal construction with a brass-tone finish and natural aged patina
Set includes dual hinged-lid inkwells, one ceramic insert, horse-head letter opener, and bust-handle spoon
Detailed gnome figure casting and ornate scrollwork base
Approximate dimensions: 8" wide x 6" deep x 5.5" high
Condition:
Good vintage condition with natural oxidation and patina consistent with age. One inkwell is missing its interior liner; the other contains a white ceramic liner with visible ink staining. Hinges are intact and functional. Letter opener and spoon show minor surface wear. No structural breaks or repairs visible.

280285553.description:
Mixed Mineral and Crystal Specimen Lot
Ten Pieces
6.98 lbs total weight
This diverse collection features ten distinct mineral specimens, artisan carvings, and crystalline formations. The lot is highlighted by a significant raw Himalayan pink salt crystal and a large, stylized carved green stone chameleon. Other prominent pieces include a crystalline amethyst geode section, a hand-crafted stone tree with green mineral leaves on an amethyst cluster base, and polished selenite and citrine towers. The assortment is completed by two small carved animal figurines, a polished heart-shaped stone, and a marbled orange stone container.
Large carved green stone chameleon measuring 6.25" x 2.25" x 3.25"
Crystalline specimens including Amethyst, Selenite, and Citrine towers
Natural Himalayan pink salt crystal and raw amethyst geode section
Includes decorative stone tree and carved animal figurines (seal and bear)
Condition:
Good pre-owned condition. All items exhibit some level of chips, surface scratches, and typical usage wear consistent with the materials. The carved chameleon has surface texture variations and minor edge wear. The salt crystal features natural irregularities. The stone tree and amethyst base are intact. Total weight is 6.98 pounds as verified by the photographed scale.
